'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Bangladesh quota reform movement]]
**[[Trial of Sheikh Hasina]]
***The prosecution of the [[International Crimes Tribunal (Bangladesh)|International Crimes Tribunal]] in [[Bangladesh]] formally announces that it seeks the [[death penalty]] against former [[Prime Minister of Bangladesh|prime minister]] [[Sheikh Hasina]] and former [[Minister of Home Affairs (Bangladesh)|home minister]] [[Asaduzzaman Khan]] over alleged [[crimes against humanity]] committed during last year's protests. Hasina has been in [[exile]] in [[India]] since her ousting, and Khan is also believed to be in India. [https://apnews.com/article/bangladesh-yunus-hasina-trial-death-penalty-c50ee429eefcd964b6bc36b67c93d03b (AP)]
*[[Death and state funeral of Raila Odinga]]
**Four people are killed when [[Kenya Police|police]] open fire to [[crowd control]] tens of thousands of people mourning opposition leader and former [[Prime Minister of Kenya|prime minister]] [[Raila Odinga]], as his body arrives at [[Jomo Kenyatta International Airport]] in [[Nairobi]], [[Kenya]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/kenya-security-forces-fire-at-crowds-at-odinga-funeral/a-74390855 (DW)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/mourners-storm-Kenyan-airport-receive-odingas-body-2025-10-16/ (Reuters)]

**One person is killed and 100 people are wounded during clashes in [[Lima]], [[Peru]], as protestors demands the resignation of [[President of Peru|President]] [[José Jerí]]. [https://apnews.com/article/peru-gen-z-protest-corruption-boluarte-jose-jeri-tiktok-alvarez-7ff662cbe439879be7ca0f6f7aae6e87 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Malagasy protests]], [[2025 Malagasy coup d'état]]
**After former [[Madagascar|Malagasy]] [[President of Madagascar|president]] [[Andry Rajoelina]] flees the country after losing support of the [[Madagascar Armed Forces|Armed Forces]], [[CAPSAT]] commander [[Michael Randrianirina]] forms the [[Council of the Presidency for the Re-Foundation of the Republic of Madagascar|transitional government]] and is confirmed as the interim president. [https://www.dw.com/en/madagascar-military-leader-to-become-transitional-president/a-74375773 (DW)]
**The [[African Union]] condemns the [[coup d'etat|coup]] and suspends Madagascar's membership. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/10/15/au-suspends-madagascar-as-military-leader-to-be-sworn-in-as-president (Al Jazeera)]
